# JSONLint

> The JSON Validator - Validate, format, and repair JSON online

JSONLint.com is a free web-based JSON validator and formatter. It helps developers validate JSON syntax, find errors, format messy JSON, and convert between JSON and other data formats. All tools run client-side in the browser; no data is sent to a server.

## Core Tools

- [JSON Validator](https://jsonlint.com/): Validate JSON syntax with detailed error messages and duplicate key detection
- [JSON Formatter](https://jsonlint.com/json-formatter): Format and beautify JSON with customizable indentation
- [JSON Pretty Print](https://jsonlint.com/json-pretty-print): Format JSON with readable indentation
- [JSON Minify](https://jsonlint.com/json-minify): Compress JSON by removing whitespace
- [JSON Diff](https://jsonlint.com/json-diff): Compare two JSON documents and highlight differences
- [JSON Repair](https://jsonlint.com/json-repair): Automatically fix common JSON syntax errors
- [JSON Error Analyzer](https://jsonlint.com/json-error-analyzer): Get detailed explanations for JSON parsing errors
- [JSON Tree](https://jsonlint.com/json-tree): Visualize JSON as an interactive tree structure
- [JSON Path](https://jsonlint.com/json-path): Query JSON using JSONPath expressions
- [JSON Search](https://jsonlint.com/json-search): Search for keys and values within JSON
- [JSON Formatter for Chrome](https://jsonlint.com/json-formatter/chrome-extension): Browser extension that formats raw JSON pages with color-coding and collapsible trees

## Code Generators

- [JSON to TypeScript](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-typescript): Generate TypeScript interfaces from JSON
- [JSON to Python](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-python): Generate Python dataclasses from JSON
- [JSON to Go](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-go): Generate Go structs from JSON
- [JSON to Java](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-java): Generate Java classes from JSON
- [JSON to Kotlin](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-kotlin): Generate Kotlin data classes from JSON
- [JSON to Swift](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-swift): Generate Swift Codable structs from JSON
- [JSON to Rust](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-rust): Generate Rust structs with serde from JSON
- [JSON to C#](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-csharp): Generate C# classes from JSON
- [JSON to PHP](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-php): Generate PHP classes from JSON
- [JSON to SQL](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-sql): Generate SQL INSERT statements from JSON

## Format Converters

- [JSON to CSV](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-csv): Convert JSON arrays to CSV
- [CSV to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/csv-to-json): Convert CSV data to JSON
- [JSON to YAML](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-yaml): Convert JSON to YAML
- [YAML to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/yaml-to-json): Convert YAML to JSON
- [JSON to XML](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-xml): Convert JSON to XML
- [XML to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/xml-to-json): Convert XML to JSON
- [JSON to Excel](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-excel): Export JSON to an Excel spreadsheet
- [Excel to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/excel-to-json): Convert Excel spreadsheets to JSON
- [SQL to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/sql-to-json): Convert SQL results to JSON
- [JSON to Markdown](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-markdown): Convert JSON to Markdown tables
- [JSON to Table](https://jsonlint.com/json-to-table): Display JSON as HTML tables
- [JSONC to JSON](https://jsonlint.com/jsonc-to-json): Strip comments from JSONC

## Utility Tools

- [JSON Sort](https://jsonlint.com/json-sort): Sort JSON keys alphabetically
- [JSON Flatten](https://jsonlint.com/json-flatten): Flatten nested JSON to dot notation
- [JSON Escape](https://jsonlint.com/json-escape): Escape JSON strings
- [JSON Unescape](https://jsonlint.com/json-unescape): Unescape JSON strings
- [JSON Stringify](https://jsonlint.com/json-stringify): Convert values to JSON string format
- [JSON Base64](https://jsonlint.com/json-base64): Encode and decode JSON as Base64
- [JSON Token Counter](https://jsonlint.com/json-token-counter): Count tokens for LLM context limits
- [JSON Size Analyzer](https://jsonlint.com/json-size-analyzer): Analyze JSON structure and size
- [JSON Schema Generator](https://jsonlint.com/json-schema-generator): Generate JSON Schema from JSON
- [JSON Schema Validator](https://jsonlint.com/json-schema): Validate JSON against a schema
- [JWT Decoder](https://jsonlint.com/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JWT tokens

## Guides

- [JSON Format: Syntax, Data Types, Rules, and Examples](https://jsonlint.com/mastering-json-format): JSON syntax with valid examples of objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null, escaping, nesting, and common mistakes
- [JSON Parse Error: How to Find and Fix Invalid JSON](https://jsonlint.com/json-parse-error): Fix JSON parse errors with examples for unexpected tokens, trailing commas, quotes, escapes, and incomplete data
- [Unexpected Token in JSON](https://jsonlint.com/unexpected-token-in-json): Diagnose unexpected-token JSON errors by the reported character, including HTML responses, undefined values, smart quotes, and BOMs
- [Unexpected End of JSON Input: Causes and Fixes](https://jsonlint.com/fix-unexpected-end-of-json-input): Fix errors caused by empty responses, truncated data, missing brackets, and incomplete strings
- [How to Open a JSON File](https://jsonlint.com/how-to-open-json-file): Open, view, format, and edit JSON files on Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web
- [Comments in JSON](https://jsonlint.com/json-comments): Why comments are invalid in standard JSON and the safe alternatives, including JSONC and JSON5
- [JSON Date Format](https://jsonlint.com/json-date-format): Represent dates and timestamps with ISO 8601 strings, UTC offsets, Unix time, and JSON Schema
- [JSON Lines (JSONL) and NDJSON](https://jsonlint.com/json-lines): How JSON Lines stores one JSON value per line for streaming, logs, data pipelines, and large files
- [JSON Multiline Strings](https://jsonlint.com/json-multiline-string): Why raw multiline strings are invalid JSON and how to encode line breaks
- [JSON Patch: RFC 6902](https://jsonlint.com/json-patch): JSON Patch add, remove, replace, move, copy, and test operations, JSON Pointer paths, and Merge Patch differences
- [JSON Schema Examples](https://jsonlint.com/json-schema-examples): Practical JSON Schema examples for required fields, nested objects, arrays, enums, and conditional shapes
- [JSON vs JSONB in PostgreSQL](https://jsonlint.com/json-vs-jsonb): Compare PostgreSQL json and jsonb storage, indexing, and query performance
- [JSON vs XML](https://jsonlint.com/json-vs-xml): Compare JSON and XML syntax, schemas, namespaces, performance, and API support
- [YAML vs JSON](https://jsonlint.com/json-vs-yaml): Compare YAML and JSON syntax, readability, comments, data types, tooling, and security
- [JSON.parse() in JavaScript](https://jsonlint.com/mastering-json-in-javascript): Use JSON.parse safely with reviver examples, fetch response checks, and error handling
- [Read and Write JSON Files in Python](https://jsonlint.com/python-json): Parse and serialize JSON in Python with json.load, loads, dump, and dumps

## Resources

- [Learn JSON](https://jsonlint.com/learn): Tutorial on JSON syntax and best practices
- [All Tools](https://jsonlint.com/tools): Complete list of all JSONLint tools
- [JSON Error Codes](https://jsonlint.com/errors): Reference for every JSON validation error and warning, with examples and fixes
- [Sample Datasets](https://jsonlint.com/datasets): Example JSON datasets for testing, each with its own page under /datasets/
- [JSONLint Pro](https://jsonlint.com/pro): Native JSON editor for macOS that works offline and handles large files
- [About](https://jsonlint.com/about): About JSONLint

## Mac App

[JSONLint Pro](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jsonlint-pro/id6757896437?mt=12) - Native Mac app with offline validation, no ads, and all the power of JSONLint on your desktop. Available on the Mac App Store for $6.99.

## Technical Details

- All processing happens client-side in the browser
- No data is sent to servers
- Works offline after initial page load
- Free to use with no account required
